Stops the notification SDK from requesting a token for every Google account on the device, which under MicroG shows an "Account ... requested by Google News" notification per account. Account-bound push notifications are no longer register…

Opens articles in your default browser through Custom Tabs instead of the in-app WebView, so browser ad blockers and extensions apply.

Renames the app and routes Google sign-in through MicroG (GmsCore) instead of Google Play Services, so the patched app installs next to the stock app.
